title: Guam: missing his brother and Howard Johnson
summary: On a stopover in Guam they visited a New York band and found that Holmes's brother and Howard Johnson had just left.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: And we're on our way to Manila, but we stopped over in Guam. And that's where the rest of the show caught up with us the next day. They caught up with us. Well, Guam wasn't no big deal. The only thing about it, one of the outfits was there that I... Well, we all knew quite a few of the fellows in the band, because there was a band on there from New York here that had a bunch of musicians that we all knew. So my brother, he had been stationed on Guam, too, but he had just went home... I guess the same time we were leaving New York, he left out there to come back to the States. So I missed him. And Howard Johnson, he was stationed out there, too, and I guess the same thing happened to him, because we went out to where his company was located, and most of the fellows that I knew, they had just left, you know, within a few days ago. And Howard wasn't there... A few of them were there.

Well, anyway, we stayed awhile, and then we come on back to our area. And the next day we left there, and then they shipped us off to Manila. Well, when we got into Manila, I guess we was in the back end of Manila someplace...
